component.name: Crate Decks
component.summary: DJ software that uses your Crate server as its library

description.p: Crate Decks is desktop DJ software that uses a Crate server as its library and brain: the remote library, Crate's analysis, recommendations and Smart Mix, on the decks.
Crate Decks is based on Mixxx, the free DJ software made by the Mixxx Development Team.
